name: Genbu no Shin
source:
Earth Age: 21 years old.
Special Trait: Long hair tied in a ribbon & glasses (he takes off when fighting)
Element: Wind
Abilities: Can control time/Owns the Genbu Shield/Defense Type

Quiet, intellectual and reserved.
The planner type whose personality is a mix between kind and cold.
He's patient and will always follow what he believes without wavering.
